Triage: **`pm:queue`** (objectui in-repo card — the fix lands in `packages/data-objectstack`; the framework/spec side is a read-only confirmation, so no transfer).

**Classification rationale.** Concrete declared-vs-contract drift with a named location and a minimal fix direction: the hand-written `fields` element type omits `percentScale`, which spec explicitly tells renderers to consume (objectui#3136). Three in-repo packages already read the field through local types, so the adapter's return type is actively steering external authors toward the guess-by-value behaviour #3136 bans. The body's **direction B** (replace only the `fields` element with the spec-owned type) is self-contained and does not assert anything about the rest of the envelope — dispatch with B as the default; A only if the dev verifies the route returns the full `AnalyticsResult`.

**Anchor verification** (objectui `origin/main` @ `b1204af`): `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:3213` still declares the five-key `fields` element without `percentScale`; `packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts:34` still carries the local `percentScale?: PercentScale` the consumers use instead. Facts live.

**Dedup**: #3613 is the same drift family on the parameter side (`selection`) and is referenced as the provenance; this card is the return-value side, filed separately per PD #10. No open duplicate.
